solution.key_idea: Yusuf needs two turns before Lou, so clue 2 leaves Lou only the last turn, and Yusuf boarded second.
steps: By clue 2, Lou boarded either first or last.
By clue 1, Yusuf boarded two turns before Lou. Nobody boarded before the first passenger, so Lou boarded fourth.
Then by clue 1, Yusuf boarded second.
By clue 3, Otis boarded after Yusuf. Third is the only later turn still open, so Otis boarded third.
Greta boarded first, and the twice-punched third ticket belonged to Otis.
solution.epilogue: Jonah apologized to Otis at the gangway on the way home. Otis said two holes just meant twice the ride, and whistled a shanty about it, slightly off-key.
